datasets.name: ds_driver_race
queryLines:
SELECT b.*,
       CASE WHEN b.dnf_flag                      THEN 'retired'
            WHEN b.quali_to_finish_delta >=  2   THEN 'made up places'
            WHEN b.quali_to_finish_delta <= -2   THEN 'lost places'
            ELSE 'held position' END AS form_verdict
FROM (
SELECT d.season, d.round, d.race_date, d.race_name,
       d.circuit_name, d.circuit_country,
       d.driver_name,
       d.constructor_name_as_of_race            AS team,
       d.grid_position, d.finish_position, d.positions_gained,
       d.quali_position, d.quali_stage_reached, d.quali_to_finish_delta,
       d.race_points, d.sprint_points, d.total_points,
       d.dnf_flag, d.status, d.is_win, d.is_podium, d.is_points_finish,
       p.pace_deficit_pct, p.consistency_s, p.laps_led, p.median_clean_lap_s,
       s.stops, s.stints, s.avg_service_stop_s, s.strategy_vs_field
FROM driver_performance d
LEFT JOIN lap_pace p
       ON p.season = d.season AND p.round = d.round AND p.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN race_strategy s
       ON s.season = d.season AND s.round = d.round AND s.driver_id = d.driver_id
) b

datasets.name: ds_driver_season
queryLines:
-- Reads the governed metric view, not the marts. Every measure below has one
-- definition in sql/metrics/driver_performance_metrics.sql, so this dataset and
-- a Genie answer cannot drift apart.
WITH per_driver AS (
  SELECT `Season`                            AS season,
         `Driver`                            AS driver_name,
         `Team`                              AS team,
         MEASURE(`Starts`)                   AS races,
         MEASURE(`Total Points`)             AS points,
         MEASURE(`Wins`)                     AS wins,
         MEASURE(`Podiums`)                  AS podiums,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`Average Qualifying`), 2) AS avg_quali,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`Average Finish`), 2)     AS avg_finish,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`Places Made Up`), 2)     AS avg_places_made_up,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`Pace Deficit`), 3)       AS avg_pace_deficit_pct,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`Consistency`), 3)        AS avg_consistency_s,
         MEASURE(`Laps Led`)                 AS laps_led,
         MEASURE(`Retirements`)              AS dnfs,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`DNF Rate`), 1)       AS dnf_rate_pct
  FROM driver_metrics
  GROUP BY ALL
),
-- Team pace comes from the same view at team grain, so it stays race-weighted.
-- Averaging the driver averages would silently reweight it by driver count.
per_team AS (
  SELECT `Season` AS season, `Team` AS team,
         MEASURE(`Pace Deficit`) AS team_pace_deficit
  FROM driver_metrics
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT d.*,
       ROUND(d.avg_pace_deficit_pct - t.team_pace_deficit, 3) AS pace_vs_team_pct
FROM per_driver d
LEFT JOIN per_team t ON t.season = d.season AND t.team = d.team

datasets.name: ds_team_season
queryLines:
-- Governed measures only. Points, pace, pit work and reliability all resolve
-- through the metric view, so the scorecard cannot disagree with Genie.
SELECT `Season`                                AS season,
       `Team`                                  AS team,
       MEASURE(`Starts`)                       AS car_races,
       MEASURE(`Total Points`)                 AS points,
       MEASURE(`Wins`)                         AS wins,
       MEASURE(`Podiums`)                      AS podiums,
       ROUND(MEASURE(`Average Qualifying`), 2) AS avg_quali,
       ROUND(MEASURE(`Average Finish`), 2)     AS avg_finish,
       ROUND(MEASURE(`Pace Deficit`), 3)       AS avg_pace_deficit_pct,
       ROUND(MEASURE(`Average Pit Stop`), 2)   AS avg_pit_stop_s,
       ROUND(MEASURE(`DNF Rate`), 1)           AS dnf_rate_pct,
       ROUND(MEASURE(`Points Finish Rate`), 1) AS points_finish_pct
FROM driver_metrics
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING `Team` IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: ds_circuit
queryLines:
WITH outcomes AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, circuit_country, season, round,
         SUM(CASE WHEN grid_position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS poles,
         SUM(CASE WHEN grid_position = 1 AND is_win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS pole_wins
  FROM driver_performance
  GROUP BY circuit_name, circuit_country, season, round
),
strategy AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, season, round,
         MAX(field_modal_stops) AS modal_stops,
         MAX(field_stop_spread) AS stop_spread
  FROM race_strategy
  GROUP BY circuit_name, season, round
),
conditions AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, season, round, avg_abs_positions_changed,
         retirement_rate_pct, was_wet
  FROM race_conditions
)
SELECT o.circuit_name, o.circuit_country,
       COUNT(*)                                            AS races,
       MODE(s.modal_stops)                                 AS typical_stops,
       ROUND(AVG(s.stop_spread), 2)                        AS avg_stop_spread,
       ROUND(AVG(c.avg_abs_positions_changed), 2)          AS overtaking_index,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.pole_wins) / NULLIF(SUM(o.poles), 0), 1) AS pole_to_win_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(c.retirement_rate_pct), 1)                AS avg_retirement_rate_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.was_wet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS wet_races
FROM outcomes o
LEFT JOIN strategy s   ON s.circuit_name = o.circuit_name AND s.season = o.season AND s.round = o.round
LEFT JOIN conditions c ON c.circuit_name = o.circuit_name AND c.season = o.season AND c.round = o.round
GROUP BY o.circuit_name, o.circuit_country

datasets.name: ds_strategy
queryLines:
SELECT season, round, race_name, circuit_name,
       driver_name,
       constructor_name_as_of_race AS team,
       stops, stints, first_stop_lap,
       avg_service_stop_s, fastest_stop_s,
       field_modal_stops, field_stop_spread, strategy_vs_field,
       positions_gained, finish_position, dnf_flag
FROM race_strategy
WHERE finish_position IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: ds_race_conditions
queryLines:
SELECT season, round, race_date, race_name, circuit_name, circuit_country,
       weather_available, precipitation_mm, rain_mm,
       temp_max_c, temp_min_c, wind_max_kmh, conditions,
       was_wet, rainfall_verdict,
       drivers_classified, retirements, retirement_rate_pct,
       avg_abs_positions_changed AS overtaking_index,
       winner, winner_grid_position, winning_constructor
FROM race_conditions
WHERE weather_available

datasets.name: ds_championship
queryLines:
SELECT season, round, race_date, race_name, driver_name,
       constructor_name_as_of_race AS team,
       championship_position, cumulative_points, cumulative_wins,
       gap_to_leader, points_gained_in_round, position_change_vs_prev_round,
       is_championship_leader
FROM championship_progression

datasets.name: ds_dq
queryLines:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT origin.update_id AS update_id, timestamp AS event_time,
         origin.flow_name AS dataset_name,
         explode(from_json(
           get_json_object(details, '$.flow_progress.data_quality.expectations'),
           'ARRAY<STRUCT<name STRING, passed_records BIGINT, failed_records BIGINT>>'
         )) AS x
  FROM pipeline_event_log
  WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress'
    AND get_json_object(details, '$.flow_progress.data_quality.expectations') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT dataset_name, x.name AS expectation_name,
       SUM(x.passed_records) AS passed_records,
       SUM(x.failed_records) AS failed_records,
       MAX(event_time)       AS last_run
FROM e GROUP BY dataset_name, x.name

datasets.name: ds_driver_standings
queryLines:
WITH final AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(round) AS last_round FROM championship_progression GROUP BY season
),
standings AS (
  SELECT c.season,
         c.championship_position          AS position,
         c.driver_name,
         c.constructor_name_as_of_race    AS team,
         c.cumulative_points              AS points,
         c.cumulative_wins                AS wins,
         c.gap_to_leader
  FROM championship_progression c
  JOIN final f ON f.season = c.season AND f.last_round = c.round
)
SELECT s.*,
       MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN points END) OVER (PARTITION BY season)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN position = 2 THEN points END) OVER (PARTITION BY season) AS title_margin,
       MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN points END) OVER (PARTITION BY season) AS champion_points
FROM standings s

datasets.name: ds_constructor_standings
queryLines:
WITH final_round AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(round) AS last_round FROM constructor_standings GROUP BY season
),
official AS (
  SELECT s.season,
         s.championship_position AS position,
         s.constructor_name      AS team,
         s.cumulative_points     AS points,
         s.cumulative_wins       AS wins,
         s.gap_to_leader
  FROM constructor_standings s
  JOIN final_round f ON f.season = s.season AND f.last_round = s.round
),
extras AS (
  SELECT season, constructor_name_as_of_race AS team,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_podium THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS podiums,
         SUM(CASE WHEN dnf_flag  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dnfs,
         COUNT(DISTINCT driver_name)                AS drivers
  FROM driver_performance
  WHERE constructor_name_as_of_race IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY season, constructor_name_as_of_race
)
SELECT o.season, o.position, o.team, o.points, o.wins, o.gap_to_leader,
       e.podiums, e.dnfs, e.drivers,
       MAX(o.points) OVER (PARTITION BY o.season) AS winning_team_points
FROM official o
LEFT JOIN extras e ON e.season = o.season AND e.team = o.team

datasets.name: ds_constructor_progression
queryLines:
SELECT season, round, race_name,
       constructor_name AS team,
       championship_position,
       cumulative_points,
       gap_to_leader,
       points_gained_in_round,
       position_change_vs_prev_round
FROM constructor_standings

datasets.name: ds_agent_calls
queryLines:
SELECT id, session_id, DATE(called_at) AS call_date,
  CASE tool_name
    WHEN 'get_driver_season' THEN 'Looked up a driver''s season'
    WHEN 'compare_constructors' THEN 'Compared two constructors'
    WHEN 'get_championship_standings' THEN 'Checked the drivers'' standings'
    WHEN 'get_constructor_standings' THEN 'Checked the constructors'' standings'
    WHEN 'get_race_weather' THEN 'Checked measured race-day weather'
    WHEN 'find_wet_races' THEN 'Found races with heavy rainfall'
    WHEN 'search_race_reports' THEN 'Searched race reports'
    WHEN 'get_race_strategy' THEN 'Checked pit-stop strategy'
    WHEN 'find_strategy_races' THEN 'Found races with varied strategy'
    WHEN 'get_race_pace' THEN 'Checked race pace'
    WHEN 'get_season_schedule' THEN 'Checked the season schedule'
    WHEN 'get_watchlist' THEN 'Checked the watchlist'
    WHEN 'get_predictions' THEN 'Checked logged predictions'
    WHEN 'get_race_notes' THEN 'Checked saved notes'
    WHEN 'add_to_watchlist' THEN 'Added to the watchlist'
    WHEN 'log_prediction' THEN 'Logged a prediction'
    WHEN 'save_race_note' THEN 'Saved a note'
    WHEN 'remove_from_watchlist' THEN 'Removed from the watchlist'
    WHEN 'delete_prediction' THEN 'Deleted a prediction'
    WHEN 'delete_note' THEN 'Deleted a note'
    ELSE tool_name
  END AS tool_label,
  CAST(is_write AS INT) AS is_write_n,
  CASE WHEN outcome = 'ok' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_error_n,
  duration_ms
FROM agent_tool_calls
WHERE tool_name NOT LIKE 'test\_%' ESCAPE '\\'

datasets.name: ds_agent_tools
queryLines:
SELECT tool_label, COUNT(id) AS calls, SUM(is_write_n) AS writes,
       SUM(is_error_n) AS errors, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms
FROM (
  SELECT id,
    CASE tool_name
    WHEN 'get_driver_season' THEN 'Looked up a driver''s season'
    WHEN 'compare_constructors' THEN 'Compared two constructors'
    WHEN 'get_championship_standings' THEN 'Checked the drivers'' standings'
    WHEN 'get_constructor_standings' THEN 'Checked the constructors'' standings'
    WHEN 'get_race_weather' THEN 'Checked measured race-day weather'
    WHEN 'find_wet_races' THEN 'Found races with heavy rainfall'
    WHEN 'search_race_reports' THEN 'Searched race reports'
    WHEN 'get_race_strategy' THEN 'Checked pit-stop strategy'
    WHEN 'find_strategy_races' THEN 'Found races with varied strategy'
    WHEN 'get_race_pace' THEN 'Checked race pace'
    WHEN 'get_season_schedule' THEN 'Checked the season schedule'
    WHEN 'get_watchlist' THEN 'Checked the watchlist'
    WHEN 'get_predictions' THEN 'Checked logged predictions'
    WHEN 'get_race_notes' THEN 'Checked saved notes'
    WHEN 'add_to_watchlist' THEN 'Added to the watchlist'
    WHEN 'log_prediction' THEN 'Logged a prediction'
    WHEN 'save_race_note' THEN 'Saved a note'
    WHEN 'remove_from_watchlist' THEN 'Removed from the watchlist'
    WHEN 'delete_prediction' THEN 'Deleted a prediction'
    WHEN 'delete_note' THEN 'Deleted a note'
    ELSE tool_name
  END AS tool_label,
    CAST(is_write AS INT) AS is_write_n,
    CASE WHEN outcome = 'ok' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_error_n,
    duration_ms
  FROM agent_tool_calls
  WHERE tool_name NOT LIKE 'test\_%' ESCAPE '\\'
) t
GROUP BY tool_label ORDER BY calls DESC
